items.brief: Former Swift CEO Lazaro Campos joins OpenTrade as chairman
items.why: Stablecoin firm adds ex-Swift leadership; reports $300M assets locked and $1B+ annual volume.

items.brief: Mystery WSJ ad sparks fight over tokenized stocks
items.why: Highlights debate over tokenized stock trading and who is funding opposition

items.brief: Aviva adds tokenized share class to £22bn Sterling Liquidity Fund on XRP Ledger
items.why: Tokenized share class on XRP Ledger backed by £50m commitment signals institutional fund tokenization.

items.brief: Coinbase lists Ripple's RLUSD across retail, exchange and Prime platforms
items.why: RLUSD live with 1:1 USD conversion on XRP Ledger, Ethereum and Base; broadens stablecoin access.

items.brief: DTCC unit launches tokenization services for securities
items.why: Post-trade infrastructure provider frames services as practical path for tokenized securities adoption.

items.brief: DTCC tokenization service live on Canton Network and Besu with 20 firms signed up
items.why: Moves securities settlement infrastructure toward blockchain-based tokenization.

items.brief: JPMorgan, Coca-Cola, Dell object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock trading plan
items.why: Companies push back on their shares trading on a planned blockchain-based venue.

items.brief: Moody's assigns A2/P-1 investment-grade ratings to Ripple's RLUSD
items.why: Stablecoin ratings cite reserve credit quality, a signal for tokenized cash instruments.

items.brief: Robinhood's Tenev: US tokenization uncertainty deters serious assets
items.why: CEO says tokenized equities need more than temporary SEC exemption to flourish in US.

items.brief: Intel, IBM, Oracle, IonQ object to OKX-ICE tokenized stocks listing
items.why: Over 40% of proposed companies opted out, showing issuer pushback on tokenized equities.
